{{Quote|I've been in the business of sales and acquisitions for decades - centuries, if truth be told - and in that time, I've seen all kinds of objects cross my proverbial desk. These precious things never come easily, and I've always needed individuals to get them for me. I pay handsome finder's fees for unique things.|Prello the Hutt|<ref name="Scum and Villainy>[[Scum and Villainy (sourcebook)|''Scum and Villainy'']]</ref>}}
'''Prello Anjiliac''' was a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] and part of the [[Anjiliac]] clan.

==Biography==
When one of her employees, a [[Balosar (species)/Legends|Balosar]] named [[Barin Trevina]], disappeared while attempting to acquire a [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|Dark side]] object known as the [[Fell Star]], Prello hired a group to find him. She agreed to pay 1,500 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to each person in the group if Trevina were brought back alive and unharmed. She offered a further 1,500 each if they also brought back the object that Trevina had been searching for.<ref name="Scum and Villainy/>

==Personality and traits==
At under 200 years of age, Prello was relatively young for a Hutt during her time as a crime lord, and unlike others of her species, Prello seemed to genuinely care about the non-Hutt individuals that she employed. Though many of her clan resided on [[Point Nadir]], she maintained a townhouse in the upscale part of [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]] on the desert world of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]].<ref name="Scum and Villainy/>
